categoryRail.moreBehavior: Reveal all 34 context categories plus Medicine inside the rail without a modal, backdrop, route change or product-grid displacement.
categoryRail.selectionBehavior: Update the same-screen product result immediately, collapse the rail and keep the selected category visible.
categoryRail.taxonomyRule: Every canonical product has exactly one Retail primary category and one Wholesale primary category. No category may repeat a product card within a context.

productGrid.exactResultRule: The first grid contains only exact category matches and the displayed count equals those matches.
productGrid.recommendationRule: When an exact category has fewer than four products, show two complementary products in a separately labelled section without changing the exact category count.
productGrid.cardAction: ADD changes in place to minus, quantity and plus.
productGrid.decrementRule: Decreasing below the permitted minimum removes the line and restores ADD.
productGrid.basketSync: Every quantity change updates the Retail basket or Wholesale bulk-order pill immediately.

nativeRules: Implement with native Flutter widgets; never render this HTML in a WebView.
Do not change accepted Screens 01, 02 or 03.
Do not rebaseline the protected Social or YouTube slice.
Do not start native Buy implementation until the remaining connected Buy HTML journey is founder approved and frozen.
Treat this version as immutable; any approved change requires a new version.
